meta.description: Implement Command Query Responsibility Segregation for scalable architectures. Use when separating read and write models, optimizing query performance, or building event-sourced systems.

copy.tagline: 实现CQRS架构，分离读写模型以提升系统扩展性
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你正在设计或重构后端架构,需要分离读写模型来应对高并发查询。
copy.tagline_en: Implement CQRS to separate read and write models for scalable architectures.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're designing or refactoring backend architecture to handle high-concurrency reads and writes.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会按 CQRS 模式帮你把读写分开：命令由 Command Handler 校验后写入写模型，事件再经 Projector 更新读模型。需要具体模板时，它会去读 references/details.md。
howto.when: 当你要分离读写模型、独立扩展读取，或构建事件溯源系统时会触发。

howto.what_en: Claude applies CQRS patterns: commands are validated and executed by command handlers that write to the write model; events update the read model via projectors. It reads references/details.md when concrete templates are needed.
howto.when_en: Triggers when separating read and write models, scaling reads independently from writes, or building event-sourced systems.
